Description

Methane tracking with 20x20 meter pixel resolution and 100ppm-m methane emissions level -- 1% of the product-process atmospheric background (detecting natural gas storage and pipeline leaks, fracking, heavy industries, landfills, mining, tailing ponds, permafrost, wastewater, rice paddies, palm oil plantations, livestock, etc.)
